name: Jewelry and accessory craftsmanship
description: Authored jewelry and accessory craftsmanship directions that restyle the existing subject without inventing scene objects.
author: PromptStyler Next contributors

styles.name: Chased-metal surface
styles.description: A craft interpretation with shallow chased-metal surface work. Keep small tool impressions related to the existing contours.

clauses.text: A craft interpretation with shallow chased-metal surface work
Keep small tool impressions related to the existing contours
Use low soft highlights to make the relief readable

styles.name: Solder-flow join study
styles.description: A craft interpretation attentive to small existing soldered joins. Make the joining seam fine and continuous along the existing contact.

clauses.text: A craft interpretation attentive to small existing soldered joins

Use low broad light to reveal the transition between joined surfaces

styles.name: Pierced-plate openness
styles.description: A pierced-plate craft interpretation of the existing open structure. Keep the boundaries of openings consistent with the surrounding plate thickness.

clauses.text: A pierced-plate craft interpretation of the existing open structure
Keep the boundaries of openings consistent with the surrounding plate thickness

styles.description: A craft interpretation emphasizing small granular surface relief. Keep the granular detail varied but scaled consistently to the existing form.

clauses.text: A craft interpretation emphasizing small granular surface relief

clauses.text: An engine-turned metalwork interpretation of the existing surface

Use a strong but restrained relationship between dark recesses and lighter ground
